content.rendered:
Check out the new web site dedicated to the Sherwood School 2016 Capital Bond!  


This site will continue to be updated with the latest information regarding the progress and schedules of bond-related projects as they begin to get underway.  A shortcut to the web site can be found on the District web site home page.


Link: New 2016 Capital Bond Web Site
